a.what: shipped mean span head on the averaged tower
a.role: VALIDITY GATE: must reproduce 5,596/7,238 (row 6af73bef) within +/-15 rows (MPS-vs-CUDA tolerance measured on 7f2c11db: 2050 vs 2050/2048 of 2053). Outside it: every arm is void, a gap is recorded, nothing else is read.

b.what: v5 seed-1 span head on the averaged tower
b.role: the v6 recipe candidate 'average the tower, take one seed's head'

c.what: refit head on frozen averaged-tower features (line-start candidates, as served)

fit.score: candidate j: (W h_q).h_j; abstain: u.h_q (u = W^T a, the convex reparametrisation); softmax over n_lines+1; mean CE over start and end pointers
fit.params: full-rank W_start, W_end [2048,2048] and u_start, u_end [2048]; low-rank is out
fit.regularisation: ridge lambda*(||W||^2+||u||^2); lambda from {1e-4,1e-3,1e-2,1e-1} chosen by CE on a train-internal 10,000/2,000 split, never val
fit.optimizer: L-BFGS full batch on the cache, max 500 iterations per lambda; final fit on all 12,000 at the chosen lambda
fit.recovery: servable a = W^{-T} u; report cond(W_start), cond(W_end); SCORE THE RECOVERED (W, a) HEAD, not (W, u)

d.what: seed-1 tower + seed-1 head (seed 1 as trained)
d.role: reference; target 6,626 (row e1bafd6f). Second tower pass; run only after arm (a) passes.

e.superseded: the 'derivation' below is superseded for the last candidate line by amendments[0] (2026-10-06); the rest of arm (e) stands
e.what: refit head on the SAME frozen averaged-tower pass, candidates represented by each line's LAST token instead of its first
e.role: report-only probe of 'the candidate state has not read the line' (heads.py:357-358; HANDOFF/needle-span-mac-2026-10-06.md section 1b). NOT SERVABLE: qd-runtime answer.rs and qd-metal gather line starts; recipe.tag says so.
e.derivation: candidates are one entry per context line in order (shards.py:181-193). end_j = candidate_positions[j+1]-1 when candidate_positions[j+1] > candidate_positions[j]; a collapsed line (shared index) uses its shared token; the last line ends at the token before the one whose decoded text starts the '\n<|qd_context_end|>' delimiter after the last candidate (decode only; line starts are never recomputed). Validity: on every evaluated row, start_j <= end_j < start_{j+1}; if the delimiter search or the monotonicity check fails on more than 0.5% of val pointing rows, arm (e) is void and the failure count is reported, never read as a result.
e.fit: identical to arm (c), same subsample, same lambda grid and selection rule

mean_of_five_heads_logits: not run: impossible on this host. The other four v5 seeds' weights left with the deleted box; the release head is an irreversible mean; no verdict file carries pointer logits.

fit_set.stratification: family mix matched to val span: 71% qa.answer_span, 29% code.defect_class (val 5,139 / 2,099)
fit_set.length_cap_note: the bucket edge above val's max (1,015); train sequences longer than 2,084 are excluded from the draw and their count is reported

nulls.uniform_line: start=end drawn uniformly over the row's lines, abstain never; expectation computed exactly per row
nulls.random_plus_line: on code.defect_class pointing rows only: start=end drawn uniformly over the row's '+' lines (GAP-THE-DIFF-MARKS-ITS-OWN-ANSWER-FOR-THE-SPAN-HEAD); expectation computed exactly

overall_per_arm.restores: count >= 6,562 (0.9066 x 7,238, v5's worst-seed span bar from the preview record)

reading.b_vs_c: paired exact McNemar on the 7,238 rows, reported with discordant counts; no winner declared without p < 0.05
reading.e_vs_c: the discriminating cell is qa.answer_span/pointing (3,624 rows; no diff marker). '(e) reads the line better' iff (e) > (c) on that cell with exact McNemar p < 0.05; on code.defect_class/pointing the '+' marker is inside the line for both, so that cell is reported, not read. Floor: the uniform-line null on the same cell.
reading.per_cell: every arm reported on all four cells plus both nulls; defect pointing cells are read against the random-'+' null, never the uniform one

amendments.recorded: 2026-10-06, after a tokenizer-only census of the val shard and before any tower was loaded or any arm scored. Read: build/needle-span-mac-2026-10-06/cache/avg-val/census.json (sha256 b05069fd78b8c64014e37e3b4880ac06cb6ade95bfc5203f9dd2192da91901d2), which holds derivation counts only (no logits, no scores). The original wording is preserved in commit ee1dfab.
amendments.finding:
1,448 of 7,238 val span rows fail the original last-line rule, all code.defect_class (1,256 pointing, 192 abstain; qa.answer_span 0). The context's last line is whitespace-only with no trailing newline, so BPE merges it with the renderer's '
' before <|qd_context_end|> into one token (per the script agent's message, not in the census file: ' 
' on 1,076 rows and '
 
' on 362, which leaves 10 of the 1,448 unattributed); the token that starts the delimiter IS the last line's start token, and the original rule gives end_last = start_last - 1.
amendments.rule: For the LAST candidate only: if the delimiter's leading newline lies inside the token at start_last, then end_last = start_last, confirmed per row by the token at start_last + 1 decoding to the beginning of '<|qd_context_end|>' (the marker without its newline); a row where that does not hold is a derivation failure, counted and never patched. Every other line keeps the original rule. Monotonicity unchanged: start_j <= end_j < start_{j+1} everywhere, and end_last < the marker's first token.
amendments.void_rule: Arm (e) is void iff derivation failures exceed 0.5% of qa.answer_span/pointing rows (its reading cell, per reading.e_vs_c). The code.defect_class cells report their failure count beside their result; they were already 'reported, not read'.
amendments.by: Fable ruling (advisor), relayed by this session; same file, explicit path, pre-result.
